_readme: Single source of truth for the payload pod. 'confirmed' says whether the number comes from a datasheet or a caliper measurement. Anything false MUST be measured on your parts before printing: edit it here, run check_fit.py, then render pod.scad.

tube.note: Design choice. 116 mm OD slides into the 174 mm bore of the existing 180 mm acrylic hull; verify the real tube bore with calipers before relying on that.

nucleo.source: ST UM1724 NUCLEO-F446RE board outline 70.0 x 82.5 mm; height is typical with ARDUINO/morpho headers fitted: measure yours

afe.note: Planned 60 x 40 mm perfboard for hardware/analog/aquasdr_afe. Measure the board you actually use.

cell.source: standard 18650 maximum outline for an unprotected cell (18.6 x 65.2 mm); a protected cell is up to ~69 mm

battery.note: Pack envelope is DERIVED from the repo's stated 3S2P 18650 pack (shared/signal.js PACK) and the standard cell outline: width = series x 18.6 + wrap, height = parallel x 18.6 + wrap, length = 65.2 + protection board/leads. The real pack was not measured; measure it with calipers (the tight height margin is why it matters).
